content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working with a larger program on [product_name]. Now I'm trying to connect to a second [product_name] in a network project. However, when copying the program, I can only transfer the text portions and the displayed variable values on the screen get cleared. Is there a way to also copy these displayed variable values? This relates to text message settings. The situation is the same for both [product_name] V7 and V8. thanks [user_name]

When you copy parts of a program or an entire program from one diagram to another, the references are not transferred automatically. You need to manually restore these references after copying. Alternatively, you can duplicate the original program and then modify the copied version as needed. If your source program is based on one module version and the copy is intended for another, all you need to do is select the appropriate device type during setup.

analysis.insight_summary: A user shares that, during program transfer between devices using [company_name] software, only the text segments are copied while references to displayed variable values and message configurations are not. Restoring these after copying requires manual work, slowing down efficiency when transferring programs across different devices in a networked setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes for all displayed variable values and message settings, not just static texts, to be reliably copied during program transfers between [product_name] devices and versions.
